summary: An interactive 3D atlas of neurovascular anatomy for studying cerebral arteries, veins, venous sinuses and their relationships to the brain and skull base. Vascular structures are original reconstructions; skull and brain models are adapted from existing anatomical datasets.

paragraph.text: The atlas is developed by Jeremy Lynch and Sean McIlhone. Jeremy Lynch is a consultant interventional and diagnostic neuroradiologist at
, in the Oxford Specialist Handbooks series.

The atlas provides an anatomical reference for neurointervention and interventional neuroradiology. Relevant areas of study include cerebral angiography, brain aneurysm treatment, stroke thrombectomy and embolisation.

intro.tagline: Interactive 3D anatomy for neurointervention and interventional neuroradiology.
intro.description: Explore cerebral arteries, veins and venous sinuses, with their relationships to the brain and skull base. An educational reference for cerebral angiography, brain aneurysms, stroke, thrombectomy and embolisation.
